text:
sam brown: Heads-up — planning to publish  Python + TS SDKs in ~30m. Saw a signer key mismatch on yesterday's canary, so I want a quick ops check before we push to stable. who can own the pin/registry side?

deploy-bot: release pipeline triggered for canary 0.14.0-rc.1 at 2026-03-20T10:15:00Z :gear:

ci-bot: python wheel build ✅, ts package publish failed (registry timeout). logs: https://ci.internal/runs/1798234567 :hourglass_flowing_sand:

anya singh: npm publish timeouts are flaky right now. suggest adding retry + backoff in publish script. also consider a shrinkwrap to prevent transient registry resolution issues.

maria gomez: Agree with anya. Also we should define rollback criteria now: if canary error rate >1% in first 10m OR latency >2x baseline -> rollback. Keep canary at 5% for at least 2h before broad rollout.

julian park: Minor product note — release notes must include the sync client deprecation blurb and migration guide link. I'll open the PR for the changelog now.

sam brown: Plan update: cancel immediate stable publish. We will: 1) fix TS publish retries + shrinkwrap, 2) re-run canary, 3) if canary metrics OK after 2h -> stable roll. If TS still fails we'll cut python-only stable and hotfix TS separately.

anya singh: I'll add a short publish wrapper. Example snippet: 
```
# publish with retries/backoff for npm
export NPM_RETRY=3
export NPM_RETRY_FACTOR=2
npm_config_registry=https://registry.npmjs.org npm publish --access public
```
I'll also add `npm shrinkwrap --dev` to CI and commit the lockfile to the canary branch.

pkg-bot: npm shrinkwrap file created on branch release/0.14.0-canary by anya-singh.

deploy-bot: retrying TS publish (attempt 2) now.

ci-bot: TS publish succeeded on retry at 2026-03-20T10:43:12Z. artifacts: https://ci.internal/artifacts/1798234567/ts.tgz :tada:

sam brown: Good. Increase canary traffic to 10% for 30m, then evaluate metrics. Keep stable publish on hold until we hit the metric gates.

maria gomez: I'll wire up alerts — prometheus rule to page if error_rate > 0.01 over 5m and a dashboard card for latency regressions. I'll also draft the rollback PR templates for both python-only and full rollback so ops can click-to-apply. :white_check_mark:

julian park: Posted changelog PR with deprecation note and migration link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/842. Please review.

sam brown: Thanks all. I'll post a short blurb for marketing & support about the staged rollout and deprecation language once julian's PR merges. If anything spikes I will trigger the rollback checklist in #incidents. :eyes:

anya singh: leaving a reminder to pin registry host in the publish job: `npm config set registry https://registry.npmjs.org` and add 3 retries. I'll update the CI job now and ping when done.

pkg-bot: CI job update applied by anya-singh.

sam brown: final: canary at 10% now. monitoring for 30m. stable on hold.

deploy-bot: canary traffic increase applied (10%).

ci-bot: end-to-end smoke tests passing against canary at 2026-03-20T11:02:00Z.

maria gomez: I'll run the regression evals against canary prompts after the 30m window and post results here. :mag:
_notes: thread covers publish coordination, retry/registry fixes, shrinkwrap/lockfile, canary gating, rollback criteria, and changelog/deprecation coordination
